title: Test the automatic handoff path against a fake waggledance
action: Without reading the ahd-1 worker's notes, check the ahd-1 commit against CONTEXT.md D1-D6 and add behavior tests next to the existing handoff_after_merge_door_* tests: a fake waggledance executable (test temp dir, injected the same way the code finds the binary) that answers list --json with this repo's root, runs --full with a matching and a non-matching pane, and dispatch with a run_id JSON and records its argv. Fix any defect you find in ahd-1's code and name it in the cap.
